svg.text: A listening bar for San Francisco
Every dimension and choice is a working
assumption for the owner to overturn.

(2,000 sq ft), 14'-0" to the joists of
the flats above, a slab on grade,
a glazed front and a rear yard.
No site chosen: the scheme is drawn
generic and is fitted to the lease.
Shop and bar: 13'-0", acoustic plaster on
resilient clips under the joists (a second
line to the flats), 12 in plenum.
The lantern's lid: 11'-2" inside, oak slats
over wool, carried by its own walls.
Rear rooms: 8'-6"; a plant deck above.
